subsections: 4.4.1 The one derived mass: m = 5.09 +- 0.10 keV (G212 joint 5.0886 +- 0.0969, chi2 = 1.04, p = 0.59); the ladder m = k_B T_0 (1+z*)/sigma^2 at z* = 2.37-2.49, T_b = 9.2-9.5 K = the CMB at cosmic noon; environment-blind (11/11 rungs recover m in [5.0000, 5.0001] keV, spread 0.00012 keV); the double-Z (Z = 2 sqrt(8 pi/3) = 5.7888, m ~ Z^(+1/2), ladder band [4.9992, 5.1887] inside the measured [4.99, 5.19] at -0.05 sigma, Z11 ratio 1.00005); the massless UFD rung breaks exactly where the freeze map says (34/34 above the 6.0-keV kill top); the forest cross-check m >= 3.3-5.7 keV

4.4.2 The line: E = m/2 = 2.5443 keV (band [2.50, 2.60]); sigma_E = 1.19 eV, envelope [1.19, 8.08] eV Doppler-dominated (caustic footing sigma_d = 140.2 km/s, thermal 6.05 eV, core 7.16 eV); the exact b^-1 surface-brightness cusp (I(b) = pi A_ph/b + 2 A_d K(0.7) b^-0.7; composite slope [0.7, 1.0); 6.4x vs NFW's 1.4x; rate-independent at Gamma/2Gamma to 1e-10); the UFD-absence switch (present where z* >= 0, absent in the 34 never-froze dSphs); the lifetime bound (Gamma < 1.88e-29 s^-1, tau > 1.69e12 yr cosmic; Gamma < 3.30e-33 s^-1, tau > 9.6e15 yr MW), a bound, never the mass

4.4.3 The free-streaming cut: lambda_fs = 0.558 Mpc (k_hm = 57 h/Mpc, M_hm ~ 7e5-8e6 M_sun); the two P(k) faces (particle removes R(k) = 1 by 0.293 at k = 30, 0.984 at k = 100 h/Mpc; condensed face R(k) = 1, 1-R = 0.000); the deciding decade k ~ 100-500 h/Mpc (the sub-halo decade 1e5-1e8 M_sun; census already leans 3.2-4.1 sigma: N_obs(>1e5) = 19 vs 5.1/1.0 relic); the G156 charge-vs-relic declaration; Delta N_eff ~ 0 (r = 1 excluded at >= 9 sigma); the sector is not a thermal relic population (occupation e^-6.44e6 = 10^-2.8e6; condensed at z* = 2.4 at delta = 1.3e5)

4.4.4 The thermodynamic face: the maximally-soft isothermal EOS (P = sigma^2 rho exactly, gamma = 1, C_V = N k_B, c_s^2 = sigma^2); the sqrt-2 sound lag (t_sound/t_dyn = 1.414214 exactly, machine-checked; c/c_s = 327 at HeCS); the phantom-first merger clocks (tau_ph = R/c = 1.90 Myr << t_sound = 621 Myr ~ t_gas ~ 1e8 yr << t_dust = never; D05's signature ordering); the thermal fixed point (T_b = 9.52-9.69 K locked to sigma^2; dT_rms/T = N^-1/2 = 2.65e-37; the 0.076-dex scatter 6.6e35x non-thermal; no heating by Landau + collisionless -- the Bullet's ordered 8-sigma offset); the gapless sound branch

4.4.5 The honest limits: no rate (a bound, never a value); no coupling/mixing/production (sin^2 2 theta not set; sterile illustrations analog); f_b = 0.157 an input (halo-anchored at 4%, two-rung band [0.150, 0.157], envelope [0.139, 0.180]; the per-object laws are f_b-invariant, D02); m_p/mu are units of the baryonic rung, not derived; the charge-vs-relic declaration awaits the G156 decade; the universe-side bookkeeping (Omega_dust = 0.2619 = 99.2% of Omega_dm, sum = 1.000)

4.4.6 The testable-predictions table: the B10 17 rows condensed to the paper's 8 most decisive (the mass; the line energy; the line width; the b^-1 cusp; the UFD absence; the cut/R(k) = 1 with the deciding decade; the temperature law + SZ-class inverse; the sound-speed/no-heating/phantom-first response), each with instrument, expected date, and verbatim falsifier

4.4.7 The falsifiers, named: 9 kill conditions (m outside [4.6, 5.2] / hard [4, 6] keV; E outside [2.50, 2.60]; sigma_E outside [1.2, 8.1] eV; F(b) flatter than 1/b; a line from a never-froze dwarf; R(k) < 1 at k <~ 57 h/Mpc or R(k) = 1 in the 1e5-1e8 decade; (M_b, T) outside the 0.06-dex band; response speed != sigma / lag != sqrt-2 t_dyn / dark thermalization / t_dark >= t_gas (D05); the z ~ 2.5 BTFR zero point not breaking at z* = 2.4) + the honest complements (a null line is always consistent)

abstract_revision.old_sentence: The sector makes one mass prediction, m = 5.0-5.2 keV, and carries three new observables: ...
abstract_revision.new_sentence: The sector derives one mass, m = 5.09 +- 0.10 keV, environment-blind, with two parameter-free observables -- a 2.55-keV line (E = m/2; width 1.19-8.08 eV; b^-1 cusp; none in never-froze dwarfs) and a 0.558-Mpc free-streaming cut excluded by the condensed phase (R(k) = 1) -- and three further observables: an anisotropy profile rising beta ~ 0.03 -> 0.56 within 5 R500; a cluster outer envelope r**-2.40 +- 0.08, 7.7 sigma from NFW; and a wide-binary ridge pre-registered for Gaia DR4 at 30.7 sigma.
abstract_revision.note: minimal-diff revision: only the particle sentence replaced; the dust-law sentence tightened by one word; the three non-particle observables (anisotropy, outer envelope, DR4 ridge) carried over unchanged

V1_section_complete.note: Every required element present in the draft: the claim (one derived mass from the equilibrium ladder, environment-blind, the double-Z at -0.05 sigma with the multi-rung and UFD-rung controls), the line fully specified (energy, width envelope, cusp, UFD-absence switch, lifetime bound), the free-streaming cut (0.558 Mpc, the two P(k) faces, the deciding decade k ~ 100-500), the thermodynamic face (isothermal EOS, sqrt-2 lag, phantom-first merger clocks, thermal fixed point), the honest limits (no rate, no coupling, f_b an input), the testable-predictions table (8 rows from B10's 17), and 9 named falsifiers with their numbers. Measured 1668 words of prose (2175 with the table) vs the ~1500 target -- +11%, the voice pass trims parentheticals, no number to remove.

V2_integration_map.note: The section slots in as the skeleton's §4.4 (G202's numbering), between §4.3 the cluster sector and §4.5 the force-face, galaxy sector on one side, cosmology/closure faces on the other; the density-closure headline (Omega_dust = 0.2619 = 99.2%, equilibrium + dust = 1.000) retained as the closing cosmology face; cross-references to §4.1/§4.2 as written. The abstract's particle sentence revised to the final state and the revised abstract measures 218 words -- inside the 180-220 gate (trimmed from the 244-word first pass).

V3_honest_statement.note: The paper's particle section is drafted from the closed record: the mass (5.09 +- 0.10 keV, one coefficient Z spanning gravity and the ladder, environment-blind across every frozen rung, the never-froze UFD class as the registered breakdown), the line (2.5443 keV, Doppler width 1.19-8.08 eV, the rate-independent b^-1 cusp, present-frozen/absent-never-froze), the cut (0.558 Mpc as the face that would kill the charge reading; R(k) = 1 as the face the census leans 3.2-4.1 sigma toward; the deciding decade k ~ 100-500), the thermodynamic face (isothermal, sqrt-2 lag, phantom-first the fixed point), the limits with their numbers (no rate -- a bound, never a value; no coupling or production; f_b = 0.157 the last measured input). Nine falsifiers armed; the honest complements ride with them (a null line is always consistent; no null in any radiative channel touches the mass). Ready for the author's voice pass.
